statement: theorem two_pair_norm {A B C : Type} [IntModule A] [IntModule B] [IntModule C] (f : A → B) (fh : B → A) (g : B → C) (gh : C → B) (n m : Int) (hf : ∀ a, fh (f a)=n • a) (hfh : ∀ b, f (fh b)=n • b) (hg : ∀ b, gh (g b)=m • b) (hgh : ∀ c, g (gh c)=m • c) (fh_linear : ∀ z : Int, ∀ b, fh (z • b)=z • fh b) (g_linear : ∀ z : Int, ∀ b, g (z • b)=z • g b) : (∀ a, fh (gh (g (f a)))=(n*m) • a) ∧ (∀ c, g (f (fh (gh c)))=(n*m) • c)

theorem inverse_on_full_annihilator {A B : Type} [IntModule A] (f : A → B) (fh : B → A) (n order inverse quotient : Int) (dual_norm : ∀ a, fh (f a)=n • a) (bezout : inverse*n+quotient*order=1) (a : A) (annihilated : order • a=0) : inverse • fh (f a)=a

theorem retained_lift_chain {A B C J K L : Type} (pa : A → J) (pb : B → K) (pc : C → L) (g : A → B) (h : B → C) (first : J → K) (second : K → L) (first_square : ∀ a, first (pa a)=pb (g a)) (second_square : ∀ b, second (pb b)=pc (h b)) (a : A) : second (first (pa a))=pc (h (g a))
